text:
sam-cs: Quick update — HarborSafe procurement emailed asking for: Private pilot SOW, sample pricing for 4-week trial, data deletion guarantees, and SOC2 addendum. They want confirmation by EOD tomorrow. Putting renewal risk flag on the account until procurement clears.

emma-cs: On it. I'll draft a minimal SOW for a 4-week Private pilot and include HSM/KMS lines. Will ping legal for the addendum.

harborsafe-pm: Thanks — procurement also asked about rollback plan if model underperforms and acceptance criteria for go/no-go. They need a one-paragraph summary for their vendor committee.

raj-eng: For rollback we recommend: 1) canary traffic on Dedicated for first 48h, 2) automatic fallback to smaller model variant (7B-quant) if p95 > 400ms for 10m window, 3) circuit breaker at error rate > 1.5%. We can write those into the SOW. Note: Private provisioning still ~2-3 weeks.

lina-ml: Acceptance criteria (suggested): NER F1 >=0.87 on the official eval set, redaction recall >=0.95, false-hallucination cases <2% on synthetic blanks. Also list sample size for evaluation (we recommend >=500 labeled samples for formal acceptance).

legal-bot: FYI legal review turnaround for SOC2 addendum and DPA is ~5 business days. If you need expedited review, file LEG-EXPEDITE with justification.

sam-cs: Procurement timeline question — if we start benching on Dedicated this week, can we provide the committee a results summary within 5 business days? Weighing whether to start bench now vs wait until Private is provisioned.

emma-cs: Yes, we can run a dedicated-host bench and share a short report within 3 business days (perf + safety snapshot). That helps procurement decide. Then move pilot to Private when ready.

harborsafe-pm: Procurement also wants assurances on data deletion after pilot and audit log delivery format. Can you state the retention policy and the mechanism for secure wipe?

ops-bot: Standard retention: artifacts from pilot stored for 30 days post-pilot in customer bucket then deleted. For Private we can schedule a secure wipe and provide SHA256 proof of deletion for exported datasets. Ops will need signed approval from customer contact.

finance-ami: Pricing note: 4-week Private pilot estimate (13B quant) = $X/day (dedicated infra + HSM surcharge). I'll send a draft pricing table to @emma-cs. Pilot pricing can be discounted vs production, but procurement will want list price too.

emma-cs: Draft SOW snippet I'm planning to paste into the committee note:

```
SOW (summary): 4-week Private pilot to validate OCR->NER pipeline. Deliverables: perf report (p95/p99, throughput), safety eval (NER metrics, redaction, hallucination), secure wipe certificate, and enablement session. Acceptance: NER F1 >=0.87 on canonical set + redaction recall >=0.95. Pilot environment: Private VPC with customer-managed KMS/HSM.
Timeline: bench on Dedicated (3bd) -> report -> provision Private (2-3 weeks) -> 4-week pilot.
Rollback: automatic fallback to 7B-quant + circuit breaker if performance thresholds breached.
```

sam-cs: That looks good. Add a short paragraph about procurement contacts and a single PO path.

harborsafe-pm: Can we also include a clause about prompt/data reuse? Customer wants to ensure prompts and OCR outputs are not used for product-wide model training.

lina-ml: We'll add a data usage clause: no training of provider models on customer data, evaluation-only retention window 30 days, and optional delete-on-upload flag. We'll also log eval traces for debugging but only store hashes unless customer opts in.

raj-eng: Technical note for the committee: expected resource needs for pilot — 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for steady 200 req/s with micro-batching + autoscale headroom for 2x EOD bursts. This could be lowered if customer accepts lower concurrency or uses 7B fallback.

legal-bot: Please attach the vendor committee one-pager and mark LEG-EXPEDITE if they need answers <5bd.

ops-bot: Ticket updated: CS-4521 -> added task 'SOW draft + pricing' and 'Secure wipe template'. Estimated next update in thread: 72 hours.

sam-cs: Ok action list (short): 1) emma sends draft SOW + pricing to procurement, 2) finance finalizes trial pricing, 3) raj schedules Dedicated bench, 4) lina readies eval plan + 500-sample extension, 5) legal queues SOC2 addendum. We'll reconvene in this thread with the bench report. :calendar:

harborsafe-pm: Appreciate the fast turnaround. If you can get the Dedicated bench report in 3bd that will probably be enough for procurement to greenlight pilot provisioning.
